# Fortune Journals

> Fortune Journals is an open access peer-reviewed scientific publishing platform specializing in medical and life sciences research across multiple specialized journals.

Fortune Journals provides a comprehensive collection of peer-reviewed open access journals covering cardiology, psychiatry, cancer research, pediatrics, microbiology, immunology, obstetrics, and general health sciences. The platform operates under Creative Commons Attribution License and accepts submissions from researchers worldwide, with notable editorial leadership from contributors in the USA and Bangladesh.

## Main Portal

- [Fortune Journals Homepage](https://fortunescholar.org/): Main homepage for Fortune Journals open access peer-reviewed scientific publishing platform
- [Fortune Journals Index](https://fortunescholar.org/index.php): Fortune Journals homepage showcasing open access peer-reviewed journals in medicine and life sciences

## Medical Specialty Journals

- [Cardiology and Cardiovascular Medicine](https://fortunescholar.org/cardiology-and-cardiovascular-medicine-home-ccm.php): Peer-reviewed open access journal publishing research in cardiology and cardiovascular medicine
- [Journal of Cancer Science and Clinical Therapeutics](https://fortunescholar.org/journal-of-cancer-science-and-clinical-therapeutics-home-jcsct.php): Peer-reviewed open access journal focused on cancer research and clinical therapeutic advances
- [Journal of Psychiatry and Psychiatric Disorders](https://fortunescholar.org/journal-of-psychiatry-and-psychiatric-disorders-home-jppd.php): Peer-reviewed open access journal publishing research in psychiatry and psychiatric disorders
- [Obstetrics and Gynecology Research](https://fortunescholar.org/obstetrics-and-gynecology-research-home-ogr.php): Peer-reviewed open access journal dedicated to obstetrics and gynecology research
- [Journal of Pediatrics, Perinatology and Child Health](https://fortunescholar.org/journal-of-pediatrics-perinatology-and-child-health-home-jppch.php): Peer-reviewed open access journal covering pediatrics, perinatology, and child health research

## Life Sciences & Health Journals

- [Archives of Microbiology & Immunology](https://fortunescholar.org/archives-of-microbiology-immunology-home-ami.php): Peer-reviewed open access journal publishing research in microbiology and immunology
- [Fortune Journal of Health Sciences](https://fortunescholar.org/fortune-journal-of-health-sciences-home-jht.php): Peer-reviewed open access journal covering general health sciences and medical research
